Playstyle: Natural group leader. Excels at becoming Champion and converting group success into personal Glory.
Unique Action: Rally the Tribes – Spend 1 Faith → Give +1 temporary Influence to one other player this round. You name the track; otherwise it lands on their affinity track. The gift is Supply.

Playstyle: Aggressive combat specialist. High risk, high reward on Military Track.
Unique Action: Raid – Spend 1 Warrior → Gain 1 Goods + 1 Glory. If Military Track is in Low zone, lose 1 Loyalty instead of gaining Glory. The zone is settled after the Reveal.

Playstyle: Covenant guardian. Strongest at Moral/Spiritual Track and protecting the shared meter.
Unique Action: Intercede – Spend 1 Faith → Raise Covenant Meter by 1, or protect it from the next drop this round. Protecting cancels that drop outright, including a Judgment drop of 2.

Playstyle: Economic engine and political influencer (Deborah/Abdon tradition).
Unique Action: Double Portion – Spend 1 Goods → Gain 2 Goods or 1 Goods + 1 other resource.

Playstyle: Tanky stabilizer. Hard to knock down; strong when tracks fail.
Unique Action: Hold the Line – Spend 1 Warrior or 1 Faith → Reduce the Covenant penalty of one failed track by 1 this round.

Playstyle: Early momentum and scouting (pastoral warrior tradition, Gilead ties).
Unique Action: Scout Ahead – Exhaust 1 Warrior → Look at the top card of the Crisis modifier deck.
Skirmish – Spend 1 Warrior → Gain 1 Glory. If Military is Low, also gain 1 Goods. The zone is settled after the Reveal.

Playstyle: Trickster / strongman (Samson tradition). Flexible and disruptive.
Unique Action: Serpent’s Wisdom – Spend 1 Faith → Discard and redraw one pending Crisis modifier card (once per game).

Playstyle: Flexible support (Barak tradition). Good at repositioning and helping others.
Unique Action: Reposition – Move 1 of your already-placed Influence tokens to a different track (before resolution).
Stand Firm – Spend 1 Warrior → Protect yourself from the next Loyalty loss this round.
Harvest – Spend 1 Faith or rest → Gain 2 Goods.

Playstyle: Strategic planner (Tola’s stabilizing role). Information and timing advantage.
Unique Action: Study the Times – Spend 1 Faith → Look at the top two Crisis modifier cards and put them back in any order.
Bargain – Spend 1 Goods → Perform two standard resource conversions this turn.
